body.zh-Hant: 據德國歷史博物館（LeMO）與《新德意志人物傳》，弗朗茨·斐迪南1863年12月18日生於格拉茨，為卡爾·路德維希大公的長子。他先後在上奧地利龍騎兵、波希米亞步兵與匈牙利驃騎兵服役，後來以少將身分接掌駐布迪約維采的第38步兵旅。1889年魯道夫皇儲身故後，他成為哈布斯堡家族的皇位繼承人。
body.en: According to the German Historical Museum (LeMO) and the Neue Deutsche Biographie, Franz Ferdinand was born in Graz on 18 December 1863, the eldest son of Archduke Karl Ludwig. He served with Upper Austrian dragoons, Bohemian infantry and then Hungarian hussars, and later, as a major general, took over the 38th Infantry Brigade at Budweis. After Crown Prince Rudolf's death in 1889 he became the Habsburg heir to the throne.

body.zh-Hant: 據《新德意志人物傳》，1898年3月29日他被置於「最高統帥部任用」，1899年晉升騎兵上將；德國歷史博物館則記該日為任命他為皇帝的最高統帥部代理人。同一傳記稱他對先前受忽視的海軍特別著力，並反對康拉德提出的預防性戰爭。奧地利國家檔案館戰爭檔案館另編有「大公弗朗茨·斐迪南總監察長軍事辦公室」檔案，起迄年份為1898至1914年。
body.en: According to the Neue Deutsche Biographie, on 29 March 1898 he was placed at the disposal of the Supreme Command and in 1899 was promoted General of Cavalry; the German Historical Museum records the same date as his appointment as deputy to the Emperor in the supreme command of the forces. The same biography says he promoted the previously neglected navy and rejected the preventive wars proposed by Conrad. The Austrian State Archives (Kriegsarchiv) also catalogue the files of the military chancellery of Archduke Franz Ferdinand as Inspector General, dated 1898–1914.

body.en: According to the Neue Deutsche Biographie, the Emperor appointed him "Generalinspektor der gesamten bewaffneten Macht" on 17 August 1913. In June 1914 he travelled to Bosnia for manoeuvres and on 28 June was shot dead with his wife in Sarajevo. None of the sources consulted records a campaign that he personally commanded.

body.zh-Hant: 據《奧地利傳記辭典》，阿爾茲1857年6月16日生於赫曼施塔特，1878年入軍，後入總參謀部。《新德意志人物傳》記他1914年任陸軍中將並兼戰爭部司長。他於1935年7月1日在布達佩斯去世。
body.en: According to the Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon, Arz was born in Hermannstadt on 16 June 1857, entered the army in 1878 and later joined the General Staff. The Neue Deutsche Biographie says that in 1914 he became Feldmarschalleutnant and section chief in the War Ministry. He died in Budapest on 1 July 1935.

citations.quote: * Hermannstadt, 16. 6. 1857; † Budapest, 1. 7. 1935

kam als Oblt. in den Generalstab
wurde 1914 Feldmarschalleutnant und Sektionschef im Kriegsministerium

heading.zh-Hant: 野戰指揮與利曼諾瓦、戈爾利采戰役
heading.en: Field commands and the Limanowa and Gorlice battles

body.zh-Hant: 開戰時他以陸軍中將身分接掌第15步兵師，繼而指揮第6軍，1914年12月在利馬諾瓦—瓦帕努夫（Limanowa-Łapanów）戰役中參戰，並在1915年5月的戈爾利采戰役中發揮重要作用。1916年8月28日起他在羅馬尼亞戰線指揮第1軍團，該年對羅馬尼亞的戰事中領軍進入特蘭西瓦尼亞。據《讀者傳記百科》（1922，錢伯斯等編），他先指揮第15師、後指揮第6軍；1915年該軍攻佔布列斯特—立陶夫斯克要塞，1916年夏出任第1軍團司令，在特蘭西瓦尼亞擊退羅馬尼亞軍。
body.en: At the outbreak of war he took over the 15th Infantry Division as Feldmarschalleutnant and then the VI Corps; he took part in the Battle of Limanowa-Łapanów in December 1914 and had a prominent share in the Gorlice battle of May 1915. From 28 August 1916 he led the 1st Army on the Romanian front, in the 1916 campaign against Romania in Transylvania. According to the Reader's Biographical Encyclopaedia (1922, ed. Chisholm and others), he commanded first the 15th Division and then the VI Army Corps, which in 1915 captured the fortress of Brest-Litovsk; appointed to the 1st Army in the summer of 1916, he defended Transylvania against the Rumanians.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年3月2日他接替康拉德出任總參謀長。據《奧地利傳記辭典》，他主導抵擋克倫斯基攻勢；《新德意志人物傳》稱他在同年弗利奇—卡波雷托的成功之後，仍無法阻止崩潰，並於1918年11月3日簽署停戰。以上來源皆未載明他卸任總參謀長的確切日期。據勞申施泰納（Böhlau，2014），11月3日他電告各軍團司令協約國停戰條件已被接受；皇帝提議任他為軍隊最高統帥，他拒絕，並奉命通告科韋什元帥已獲任命、到任前由他代理。
body.en: On 2 March 1917 he succeeded Conrad as Chief of the General Staff. The Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon says he directed the defence against the Kerensky offensive; the Neue Deutsche Biographie says that despite the success at Flitsch-Karfreit-Tolmein that same year he could not prevent the collapse and had to conclude the armistice on 3 November 1918. None of these sources gives the exact date he left the office. According to Rauchensteiner (Böhlau, 2014), on 3 November he telegraphed all army commanders that the Entente armistice conditions had been accepted; the Emperor offered him the supreme command, which he refused, and he was to deputise for Field Marshal Kövess until the latter arrived.

mußte den Waffenstillstand am 3.11.1918 schließen

body.en: According to the Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon, Roth was born in Trieste on 21 October 1859, was commissioned lieutenant from the Theresian Military Academy in 1879 and entered the General Staff as a captain in 1889. He died in Vienna on 9 April 1927.

heading.zh-Hant: 旅長、軍校校長與軍級指揮

body.zh-Hant: 據《奧地利傳記辭典》，羅特自1908年起以少將身分指揮第94步兵旅，自1910年起任特蕾莎軍事學院校長，1912年晉升陸軍中將。一戰開戰時他任第3步兵師師長，1914年改任第14軍軍長，該軍自1917年稱愛德爾懷斯軍。
body.en: According to the Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon, from 1908 Roth commanded the 94th Infantry Brigade as a major general and from 1910 served as commandant of the Theresian Military Academy, becoming Feldmarschalleutnant in 1912. At the outbreak of war he commanded the 3rd Infantry Division, and in 1914 the XIV Corps, known from 1917 as the Edelweiss Corps.

heading.zh-Hant: 利馬諾瓦戰役與後期職務

body.zh-Hant: 1914年12月1日至20日的利馬諾瓦—瓦帕努夫戰役中，羅特統率的集團軍阻止了俄軍從奧軍第4、第3軍團之間突破。1916年起他任蒂羅爾邦防司令，1918年3月21日起任返鄉事務總監察，同年獲軍事瑪麗亞·特蕾莎勳章騎士十字。
body.en: In the Battle of Limanowa-Łapanów, 1–20 December 1914, the army group under Roth prevented the Russian armies from breaking through between the Austro-Hungarian 4th and 3rd Armies. From 1916 he was Tyrol's defence commander, and from 21 March 1918 general inspector for repatriation affairs; in 1918 he received the Knight's Cross of the Military Order of Maria Theresa.

body.zh-Hant: 據特蕾莎軍事學院所載傳記（作者上校托馬斯·蘭珀斯貝格），羅特1908年5月1日出任第94步兵旅旅長，1910年4月24日接掌軍事學院，在維也納新城任職四年。1914年8月2日他離開學院，前往林茨接掌第3步兵師；1916年3月15日出任蒂羅爾邦防司令，同年8月21日重掌第14軍，1918年12月3日退役。
body.en: According to the biography published by the Theresian Military Academy (author Colonel Thomas Lampersberger), Roth took command of the 94th Infantry Brigade on 1 May 1908 and of the Military Academy on 24 April 1910, serving four years at Wiener Neustadt. On 2 August 1914 he left the academy for Linz to take over the 3rd Infantry Division; on 15 March 1916 he became defence commander of Tyrol, resumed command of XIV Corps on 21 August 1916 and entered retirement on 3 December 1918.

heading.en: Origins and rise through the ranks

body.zh-Hant: 據《奧地利傳記辭典》，奧芬貝格1852年5月22日生於特羅保，畢業於特蕾莎軍事學院，其後入戰爭學校。《新德意志人物傳》記他1900年任少將兼旅長，1905年任陸軍中將兼師長，1909年任薩拉熱窩軍長並獲樞密顧問銜，1910年晉升步兵上將。
body.en: According to the Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon, Auffenberg was born in Troppau on 22 May 1852, graduated from the Theresian Military Academy and later the War School. The Neue Deutsche Biographie records that he became major general and brigadier in 1900, Feldmarschalleutnant and divisional commander in 1905, corps commander in Sarajevo and Privy Councillor in 1909, and General of Infantry in 1910.

citations.quote: absolvierte die Theres. Milit. Akad. und später die Kriegsschule
wurde 1900 Generalmajor und Brigadier, 1905 Feldmarschalleutnant und Divisionär
1909 Geheimer Rat und Korpskommandant in Sarajewo
1910 General der Infanterie

body.zh-Hant: 據《新德意志人物傳》，1911年他在皇儲弗朗茨·斐迪南支持下被強加給皇帝，出任戰爭部長。據《奧地利傳記辭典》，他任內推動新兵役法與重炮擴充；《新德意志人物傳》稱他1912年12月被迫辭職並改任軍團總監察。奧地利科學院《部長會議紀錄》編注載，1912年12月12日皇帝以親筆函解除其戰爭部長職務，同日以親筆函任命克羅巴廷接任。據《讀者傳記百科》（1922），他任部長僅一年又一季。
body.en: According to the Neue Deutsche Biographie, in 1911 he was imposed on the Emperor, with the backing of Crown Prince Franz Ferdinand, as War Minister. According to the Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon, in office he pushed through a new defence law and heavy-artillery expansion; the Neue Deutsche Biographie says he had to resign in December 1912 and became army inspector. The Austrian Academy of Sciences edition of the Ministerrat protocols records that on 12 December 1912 the Emperor dismissed him as war minister by autograph letter and appointed Krobatin the same day; the Reader's Biographical Encyclopaedia (1922) says he held the office for only a year and a quarter.

heading.zh-Hant: 第4軍團與科馬魯夫戰役
heading.en: Fourth Army and the Battle of Komarów

body.zh-Hant: 1914年他接掌第4軍團，8月26日至28日在科馬魯夫戰役中擊敗俄第5軍團。據《奧地利傳記辭典》，9月底他被解除職務；1915年4月25日皇帝授他男爵稱號並加「科馬魯夫」封號。
body.en: In 1914 he took over the 4th Army and on 26–28 August won a victory at Komarów over the Russian 5th Army. According to the Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon he was relieved of his post at the end of September; on 25 April 1915 the Emperor conferred on him the rank of Freiherr with the predicate "von Komarów".

body.zh-Hant: 據《Küre 百科》（作者 Cevdet Küçük），卡拉貝基爾1902年自陸軍學校、1905年自陸軍大學畢業。1908年11月19日他出任埃迪爾內第3步兵師參謀長，並曾任行動軍（Hareket Ordusu）參謀長；巴爾幹戰爭中於埃迪爾內守城時被保加利亞人俘虜，1913年獲釋。
body.en: According to the Küre Encyclopedia (author Cevdet Küçük), Karabekir graduated from the War School in 1902 and the War Academy in 1905. On 19 November 1908 he became chief of staff of the 3rd Infantry Division at Edirne, and he served as chief of staff of the Action Army (Hareket Ordusu); in the Balkan War he was captured by the Bulgarians during the defence of Edirne and released in 1913.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰的指揮

body.zh-Hant: 1915年3月6日他被任命為卡爾塔爾第14師師長，隨該師參加查納卡萊戰役，並在凱雷維茲德雷（Kerevizdere）對法軍作戰。1916年出任第18軍軍長，在庫特阿馬拉與英軍交戰。1917年12月31日任第1高加索軍軍長，1918年4月25日收復卡爾斯，5月15日進入久姆里。據學術論文（Zeyrek），1917年4月8日他改任高加索戰線第2軍軍長；1918年10月31日他在納赫奇萬接到撤銷軍司令部的命令。
body.en: On 6 March 1915 he was appointed commander of the 14th Division at Kartal, with which he took part in the Çanakkale (Gallipoli) battles and fought the French at Kerevizdere. In 1916 he became commander of the 18th Corps and fought the British at Kut al-Amara. Appointed commander of the 1st Caucasus Corps on 31 December 1917, he retook Kars on 25 April 1918 and entered Gümrü on 15 May. According to an academic article (Zeyrek), on 8 April 1917 he was appointed commander of the 2nd Corps on the Caucasian front, and on 31 October 1918, at Nakhchivan, he received the order dissolving the corps headquarters.

heading.en: Eastern Front and the reconquest of the east

body.zh-Hant: 1919年3月13日他轉任埃爾祖魯姆第15軍軍長，1920年1月14日出任東方面軍（Şark Cephesi）司令。1920年9月28日東部攻勢開始，10月30日再度收復卡爾斯；1920年12月3日簽訂久姆里條約，1921年2月23日奪回阿爾達漢。東方面軍司令部於1923年10月21日撤銷。
body.en: On 13 March 1919 he moved to command the 15th Corps at Erzurum, and on 14 January 1920 became commander of the Eastern Front (Şark Cephesi). The eastern offensive began on 28 September 1920, Kars was retaken for the second time on 30 October, the Treaty of Gümrü was signed on 3 December 1920, and Ardahan was taken on 23 February 1921. The Eastern Front command was abolished on 21 October 1923.

heading.zh-Hant: 議員、反對黨領袖與國會議長

body.zh-Hant: 1923年6月29日他當選伊斯坦堡議員，1924年10月26日辭去第1軍監察一職以保留議席；1924年11月27日當選進步共和黨主席，該黨於1925年6月3日被關閉。1938年12月31日他以共和人民黨身分成為伊斯坦堡議員，1946年7月23日當選大國民議會議長，任職至1948年1月26日去世。
body.en: He was elected deputy for Istanbul on 29 June 1923 and on 26 October 1924 resigned as First Army inspector to keep his seat; on 27 November 1924 he was elected chairman of the Progressive Republican Party, which was closed on 3 June 1925. On 31 December 1938 he became an Istanbul deputy for the Republican People's Party, and on 23 July 1946 was elected Speaker of the Grand National Assembly, serving until his death on 26 January 1948.
